title: Southwest {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Start the sides first, since they take the longest. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Trim the {p}, rub with oil, and coat evenly with the {spice} and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan 20 to 25 minutes, until {doneness}. Rest 3 minutes, then slice into medallions.
Serve the {p} with the {v} and {s}, and top with the {sauce}.
tip: Pork tenderloin is one of the leanest cuts. Add beans or extra vegetables to stretch it.
